Chapter 366: Chapter 18: Three Hundred Years Later! The Demon Ancestral Tree? No, It Is The World Tree That Shelters All Beings (Please Subscribe)_2

Chapter 366: Chapter 18: Three Hundred Years Later! The Demon Ancestral Tree? No, It is the World Tree That Shelters All Beings (Please Subscribe)_2

The middle-aged man looked toward the distant sacred tree again, admiration glowing in his eyes.

“Right,” he said.

“Damn it, the enemy has actually been hiding inside us.”

“From now on, anyone who dares to slander the sacred tree will be opposing me.”

…

The youths began to speak up, they were unclear about the battle against the Foreign Evil God invasion that had happened hundreds of years before.

...

But they could feel that the life they were living now was very good, and all of it stemmed from the sacred tree.

It’s a simple principle, what you say isn’t important, but what you do is key.

The now thriving and prosperous Tianqing World was quickly quashing those rumors and slanders doubting the sacred tree.

…

At the top of the sacred tree.

This place was close to Tianqing World’s natural barrier, and just a bit further up, you might leave the scope of the Tianqing World.

And right now, on the main trunk of the sacred tree, a figure was sitting cross-legged.

“Three hundred years,” he said.

This figure was Lin Yuan.

To be precise, it was an ‘incarnation’ derived from the Demon Tree Seed of the Ancestral Demon Tree.

After becoming the Ancestral Demon Tree, Lin Yuan had gained all the abilities of the Ancestral Demon Tree, including the Demon Seed Incarnation.

During this traversal, although he had become the Demon Tree, his essence was still human, so he directly used the Demon Seed Incarnation to take on a human form and resided within it.

“Unfortunately… most of the Ancestral Demon Tree’s innate abilities are tied to the Ancestral Demon Tree itself.”

“Even if I’ve fully comprehended them, I can’t use them in the Main World…”

Lin Yuan sighed.

For instance, the Demon Seed was something that had to be formed by the Demon Tree, and when Lin Yuan returned to the Main World, reverting to human form, he couldn’t gather the Demon Seed and therefore couldn’t perform the ‘parasitic’ techniques.

Unless Lin Yuan was willing to give up his human form and completely transform into the Ancestral Demon Tree, it might then be possible to inherit everything.

With Lin Yuan’s current understanding of the Ancestral Demon Tree, he could completely create a technique for the transformation of the essence of life through his Against-Heaven’s Understanding.

Then returning to the Main World and using this transformation technique, he could begin transforming into the Ancestral Demon Tree.

According to Human Alliance’s recognition, the definition of human beings doesn’t depend on the flesh but on the soul.

As long as Lin Yuan’s soul did not change, even if he became the Ancestral Demon Tree, he would still be counted as part of the Human Race.

But the consequences of doing that were too great, first and foremost regarding the species, the Ancestral Demon Tree could not cultivate Martial Tao.

This would turn Lin Yuan’s efforts from his past six traversals to ash.

Secondly, for Tianqing World, the Ancestral Demon Tree was considered an enormous being that required the effort of an entire world to resist.

However, in the Main World, it wasn’t as insoluble.

Even the peak bloodline beings like the Starry Sky Wanderer Kun, not to mention those other powerful and special beings, would be considerably stronger than the Ancestral Demon Tree.

And many of the Ancestral Demon Tree’s abilities, such as the highly meritorious ‘parasitic’ techniques.

It might be an unsolvable issue in Tianqing World, but in the Main World, it definitely did not count as something to be feared,

The so-called parasitic influence on the will of True Spirits, not to mention others, the constant surveillance of all humans by the three goddesses at every moment would allow them to detect any abnormalities through the details of daily behavior.

“However… if I really want to continue using the abilities of the Ancestral Demon Tree, it’s not without a way,” Lin Yuan contemplated, stroking his chin.

The simplest method would be to give up some World-Breaking Origin Force and bring a seed of the Ancestral Demon Tree to the Main World.

Then Lin Yuan would nurture it himself, and as it began to grow, he would use control techniques to keep it in check.

To the human civilization of the Main World, the Ancestral Demon Tree would at most be considered one of the rare and special forms of life.

And most of the high-rank evolvers of human civilization basically controlled some special beings for their own use.

For Lin Yuan, controlling a Demon Tree would be extremely simple.

He could even train the Ancestral Demon Tree to become his own ‘incarnation’ at that time, to better manage it.

“Bringing the whole Ancestral Demon Tree back would use up an incredible amount of World-Breaking Origin Force.”

“But just a single seed… ten strands of World-Breaking Origin Force would be the absolute limit…”

Lin Yuan shook his head slightly.

“`

The Door to the Myriad Realms had the ability to bring back items from other worlds to the Main World, consuming World-Breaking Origin Force to achieve this.

As for how much World-Breaking Origin Force was required, it depended on the size and level of the items being brought back.

The Demon Tree Seed was only the size of a fist; what kind of price could it command if brought back?

…

In three hundred years’ time, Lin Yuan had exclusive access to all the resources of the Tianqing World, and the harvest was extremely astonishing.

First, there was the nurturing of the Origin Fine Gold.

This piece, hailing from the Main World and treasured even by the Eighth Layer invincible Chikun Star Lord, who had fought life-threatening battles with several other alien strong ones of the same rank and even attracted the attention of a Ninth Rank alien race, was a cosmic rarity…

After Lin Yuan dealt with the Ancestral Demon Tree, he expended a strand of World-Breaking Origin Force to bring it into this world from the Main World.

The reason for doing so was, naturally, to incubate the Origin Fine Gold.

Of course, Lin Yuan wasn’t relying on his own strength to incubate it.

The power of the Ancestral Demon Tree leaned towards evil and chaos; if it were to nurture the Origin Fine Gold, not to mention the waste of time and effort, it might also affect the formation of the Origin Fine Gold.

The place where Lin Yuan nurtured the Origin Fine Gold… was within the Origin Vast Ocean of the Tianqing World.

The Origin Vast Ocean of a world was pure and clean, simply the best place for the incubation of the Origin Fine Gold.

Weapons like the World Sword were incubated within the World’s Origin Vast Ocean.

Lin Yuan placed the Origin Fine Gold into the Origin Vast Ocean of the Tianqing World for nurturing, and it indeed had an impact on the Tianqing World.

But the impact was minor, and Lin Yuan was only incubating it for at most a few hundred years; once Lin Yuan returned, the Tianqing World would have plenty of time to recover.

“Hmm?”

Lin Yuan looked down and vaguely saw a massive Origin Vast Ocean where a piece of metal was floating and sinking; from afar, the shape of the metal already resembled a ‘bell-shape’?

“The World’s Origin Vast Ocean has no life imprints, hence it can replace me in nurturing the Origin Fine Gold…”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

In theory, the incubation of the Origin Fine Gold could only be done by oneself.

Because if one were to use the power of others for nurturing, it would contaminate with the life imprints of the others, and then who the Origin Fine Gold truly belonged to would be unclear.

But with the World’s Origin Vast Ocean, this problem would not occur; a world consciousness is similar to an instinct and does not have so-called life imprints.

…

“Martial Arts Evolution System…”

With a shift of thought, in the three hundred years, Lin Yuan had completely developed and perfected the Seventh Stage Martial Tao Chapter, and he was even considering the path to the Eighth Layer Part.

“Although I am not cultivating the Martial Arts Evolution System, in the process of developing the Seventh Rank Chapter, my realm has also been improving. I am now at the seventh rank’s limit; as soon as I return to the Main World and consume the Red Spirit Fluid, I will be able to quickly reach the Seventh-Rank King Level Peak,” Lin Yuan thought to himself.

If Lin Yuan didn’t have the corresponding realm, he wouldn’t have been able to develop a complete Seventh Rank Chapter.

Since ancient times, it has been heard that high-rank evolvers, with their lofty insights, developed lower-rank evolutionary paths, but never has it been heard of a low-rank evolver developing a high-rank evolutionary path.

Because if the realm isn’t there, one simply cannot grasp the essence of cultivation, let alone develop it.

…

“The one thousand one hundred and thirty-third core space model…”

In Lin Yuan’s eyes, a silver sea appeared to ripple; in three hundred years, Lin Yuan had comprehended one thousand one hundred and thirty-three core space models.

It must be known that these are core space models, which explicate certain aspects of the essence of Space Rules.

Even the Chikun Star Lord, who has the enhancement from some of his own Starry Sky Wanderer Kun’s comprehension of Space Rules, has not yet fully understood all the core space models.

For Lin Yuan to comprehend over a thousand core space models at the seventh-layer level was nothing short of monstrous.

“I wonder how much these comprehensions of space models can expand my inner world…”

Lin Yuan’s expression was somewhat anticipatory.

The size of the inner world, in addition to needing a sufficiently strong physical body to bear, mainly depends on one’s understanding of Space Rules.

The deeper the understanding of Space Rules, the larger the inner world will be, and the more World force one can mobilize.

Just as Lin Yuan was about to continue his cultivation and enlightenment.

“Hmm?”

Lin Yuan’s expression slightly surprised.

The next moment, several vast consciousnesses,

From the distant Outer Void, suddenly arrived outside of the Tianqing World.
